answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where nodes lock capital to validate transactions, acting as a sturdy walnut shell protecting the network core. An attacker must acquire a ridge of staked assets exceeding fifty percent of the total supply to subvert consensus, a feat equivalent in complexity to writing a perfect sonnet by chance. This economic hurdle ensures that identity fabrication is prohibitively expensive, as the cost to attack scales linearly with the network's cumulative wealth.
